answer: Sybil resistance bonds each identity in a separately tracked escrow and correlates equivocation evidence across the consensus set. If k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, pairwise penalties scale as O(k^2), not as a fixed per-key fine. Detection also causes asymmetric, compounding depreciation of bonded capital, exposing a swarm’s controller to an exponential multiplier in aggregate loss. An atlas of attestations links each echo of misconduct to its signing voyage.
